stories.title: Remembering Mighty Sparrow, a calypso great who carried the genre into a new era
stories.summary: The legendary calypso singer Slinger Francisco, known popularly as Mighty Sparrow, has died at 91 years old.

stories.title: Five arrested near UK air base used by U.S. bombers in Iran war
stories.summary: U.K. police say five men were arrested on suspicion of preparation of a terrorist act after three vehicles were spotted near an air base the U.S. military has been using to launch attacks on Iran.

stories.title: Cornell campus rape case reopened by prosecutor as new allegations surface
stories.summary: A former Cornell University student has filed a lawsuit alleging the school didn't do enough to protect her after she says she was sexually assaulted at a fraternity house.

stories.title: Trump's immigration push has largely spared farms. Idaho dairymen worry it won't last.
stories.summary: America's farms have largely escaped the president's aggressive immigration crackdown. But as ICE sweeps continue across the nation, farmers are uneasy because many still can't find enough workers.

stories.title: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
stories.summary: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

stories.title: What to know about the $810 million in spending canceled by President Trump
stories.summary: President Trump announced plans to cancel $810 million in congressionally approved spending, a move that some in his own party are calling illegal.
